The '''Mission to Graador''' involved several [[operative]]s of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] investigating [[Graador]] as a potential base for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The operative called the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in, but then had to fight off [[mutant mynock]]s and [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] and warn the fleet off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="RECG" />
